ev.q: A dark comedy, satirizing the psychological thriller genre
creating the curiosity of its suspense
who believes she witnessed a murder, regardless of what others say
Matt Fowler of IGN criticized the overall runtime
as glacially paced as its own whopper of a title
were left puzzled with many sequences in the storyline
The eight-episode series was released on Netflix
at least Kristen Bell makes for delightfully deadpan company
